_lire: Base Saya preset installed with the package. At startup, when « version » changes: the generation workspace is prepared on pass 1 and the master + six passes are copied to ComfyUI/user/default/workflows/ILUSTCOUPLE_PASSES (an existing pass is never overwritten). Adjust the master, then outils/synchro_maitre.py copies its settings to the six passes. Nothing is deleted. No characters are shipped.
